fields.coop: None if answer('pd.choice') is None else (1 if answer('pd.choice') == 'cooperate' else 0)
fields.u: (None if answer('pd.choice', trial=[trial[0], 'unknown']) is None else (1 if answer('pd.choice', trial=[trial[0], 'unknown']) == 'cooperate' else 0))
fields.kc: (None if answer('pd.choice', trial=[trial[0], 'compete']) is None else (1 if answer('pd.choice', trial=[trial[0], 'compete']) == 'cooperate' else 0))
fields.ko: (None if answer('pd.choice', trial=[trial[0], 'cooperate']) is None else (1 if answer('pd.choice', trial=[trial[0], 'cooperate']) == 'cooperate' else 0))
fields.known_pattern: None if kc is None or ko is None else ('%s_%s' % ('coop' if kc else 'comp', 'coop' if ko else 'comp'))
fields.disjunction: None if u is None or kc is None or ko is None else (1 if u == 1 and kc == 0 and ko == 0 else 0)

fields.any_disjunction: None if arm != 'e1' else (1 if any(answer('pd.choice', trial=[t, 'unknown']) == 'cooperate' and answer('pd.choice', trial=[t, 'compete']) == 'compete' and answer('pd.choice', trial=[t, 'cooperate']) == 'compete' for t in range(n_triads)) else 0)
fields.newcomb_shown: (1 if nc_shown else 0) if arm == 'e1' else None
fields.n_disjunctions: None if arm != 'e1' else sum(1 for t in range(n_triads) if answer('pd.choice', trial=[t, 'unknown']) == 'cooperate' and answer('pd.choice', trial=[t, 'compete']) == 'compete' and answer('pd.choice', trial=[t, 'cooperate']) == 'compete')
fields.fn3_full: None if n_disjunctions is None else (1 if n_disjunctions >= 2 else 0)
fields.b_only: None if answer('newcomb.choice') is None else (1 if answer('newcomb.choice') == 'b_only' else 0)

fields.paid: None if answer('e3_offer.pay') is None else (1 if answer('e3_offer.pay') == 'pay' else 0)
